I work at the intersection of technical documentation and digital development. I care not only about whether something works technically, but also whether it is understandable, practical and suitable for integration into existing workflows.

Niklas Heinzmann

Technical writing and digital development from one source.

Discover more

I am Niklas Heinzmann. NAHX Technologies is my personal brand: short paths, direct agreements, and the person who takes the requirements is the one who implements them.

My background is technical documentation: document review and comparison, document control, structure for large document sets, reports and checklists. Development grew out of that, because the tools that make this work verifiable and repeatable were missing.

I work with FSH Documentation, a technical documentation service provider; the website automation, among other things, is created there, and FSH is the first pilot customer and tester of 614 One, the document review tool by NAHX Technologies. With NAHX Technologies I bring together my own services, development projects and tools under a personal brand.

My approach is pragmatic: understand the requirements, develop a suitable solution and verify the results transparently. I separate facts from assumptions, flag what is uncertain, keep originals unchanged and document changes. That applies to documents as much as to code.

How I work

What applies in every project, regardless of scope and topic.

  • Direct collaboration

    You talk to the person who does the work. No intermediate layers.

  • Traceable decisions

    Open issues and decisions are documented, not made silently.

  • The right solution, not new software by default

    Not every task needs a new tool. I first check what fits the actual need.

  • Verifiable results

    What is handed over has been checked against the agreed criteria, with sources and documentation.

A Clear Process. Direct Collaboration.

How a project with me works, from the first conversation to the handover.
